ShortDescription.Value: Plop any vanilla building - zoned, signature or service - as a property-free scenery piece: same model, same lot, plus the game's own randomized decorations.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Static Scenery Ploppables
**English** | 中文见下方
Plop any vanilla building exactly as it looks in your city - then keep only the looks. Every placement looks exactly like the real thing - the same building with its properties stripped: same model, same lot, same decorations, zero simulation.
**What it does** - Browse 2000+ vanilla buildings in one panel: zoned buildings, signature buildings (landmarks) and service buildings (schools, hospitals, fire stations, police & administration) - each group with its own tabs. Filters for style, density and level apply to zoned buildings, while width and depth (including a ">6 cells" option) work everywhere. Buildings from DLC packs you own are included automatically. - Building icons with real character: signature and service buildings show their own vanilla icons out of the box; if you also run the free Asset Icon Library mod, regular zoned buildings get their own icons too - entirely optional, no dependency either way. - Service buildings as pure shells: place that school or fire station anywhere, as many as you like - no cost, no unlock, no workers, no service coverage. Just the building. - Every placement rolls its own decoration variant with the game's own randomization: no two scenes are identical. - The result is a pure shell: no residents, no jobs, no households, no companies, no simulation cost.
**Why it's different** - Static-Ploppables-style mods hand you the building shell and nothing else. Here you also get the vanilla lot surface and the randomized decorations the game itself would spawn - trees, benches, planters, bins, light poles, parking-lot details. The result looks lived-in instead of empty. - It is the very same building you see when the zone grows: a working building and a scenery piece look identical; the only difference is that one has properties and the other does not. - Signature buildings join the catalog too: place them anywhere, as many as you like, with no milestone unlock required - the looks without the ceremony.
**Compatibility and safety** - The vanilla relocate tool and bulldozing behave exactly as they do with real buildings. - Uninstall-safe (verified): the save still loads and does not crash. Placed objects become missing-prefab placeholders (white models) and can be bulldozed together with their decorations. - No required dependencies. Works alongside Find It, Move It, Anarchy and ctrlC. Asset Icon Library is optional and only adds nicer icons.
**Localization**: panel text follows your game language - English, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese (BR), Russian, Polish, Japanese, Korean. Other languages fall back to English.
**Source & feedback**: https://github.com/LiangHaoXiang/StaticSceneryPloppables

# 静态造景建筑
把**任意原版建筑**原样放进城市，只留下外观。 每次放置的都是与真实建筑一致外观的「属性剥离版」：模型一样、地皮一样、装饰一样，不产生任何模拟。
**它做什么** - 在一个面板里浏览 2000+ 原版建筑：分区建筑、标志性建筑（地标）与服务建筑（学校、医院、消防局、警察与行政）——各自独立页签。风格/密度/等级筛选作用于分区建筑，面宽/进深（含「>6格」选项）对所有建筑生效。已拥有的 DLC 内容包建筑自动收录。 - 有辨识度的建筑图标：标志性与服务建筑开箱即用原版专属图标；若同时安装免费的 Asset Icon Library，常规分区建筑也会显示各自图标——完全可选，无任何前置依赖。 - 服务建筑变纯外壳：学校、消防局想放哪放哪、想放几栋放几栋——无费用、无解锁、无员工、无服务覆盖，只有建筑本身。 - 每次摆放用游戏自身的随机逻辑抽一份装饰方案，没有两处完全相同。 - 结果是纯净外壳：没有居民、没有岗位、没有住户与公司、不产生模拟开销。
**与 Static Ploppables 类模组的不同** - 那类模组给你的只是**建筑外壳**；这里还额外带上**原版地皮**与**游戏随机生成的装饰**——树木、长椅、花盆、垃圾箱、灯杆、停车场细节，场景是「有人住过」的样子，而不是空壳。 - 它就是你平时分区长出来的那栋楼本身——真实建筑与造景件**外观完全一致**，区别只在于一个有属性、一个没有。 - 标志性建筑同样入册：任意位置、想放几栋放几栋、无需里程碑解锁——只要外观，不要仪式感。
**兼容与安全** - 原版迁移与拆除操作都和对真实建筑操作的结果一致。 - 卸载安全（实测）：移除模组后存档能正常载入、不崩溃；摆放物变成白模占位，用推土机拆除白模时装饰一并清除。 - 无前置依赖，可与 Find It / Move It / Anarchy / ctrlC 共存；Asset Icon Library 为可选增强，仅提供更好的图标。
**语言支持**：面板文案跟随游戏语言——English、简体/繁体中文、德文、法文、西班牙文、葡萄牙文（BR）、俄文、波兰文、日文、韩文；其余语言回退英文。
**源码与反馈**：https://github.com/LiangHaoXiang/StaticSceneryPloppables

ChangeLog.Value: 0.4.0: garbage & transportation buildings join the catalog - garbage facilities (sorting centers, incinerators) and 63 transportation buildings (bus, train, tram and subway stations, depots and hubs, more with DLC), bringing the service categories to eight and the tabs to 14. Placement is fully scenery-clean: functional sub-nets (power lines, tracks, pipes, waterways) are filtered out so placing never triggers infrastructure XP or "needs electricity" warnings, and invisible stop markers are filtered out so stations no longer require a nearby track or road to be placed - vanilla parking on the lots keeps working. Panel improvements: Esc now cancels placement first and only closes the panel on the second press; width/depth filter chips show plain numbers (plus a new 1) with a ">6" option; the style filter row is hidden on Office and Industrial tabs (those buildings have no real style variance). 0.3.3: mod info card - selecting one of your placed buildings now shows a "User-created Content" card in the vanilla info panel, with the mod's live details (name, author, mod ID, version, subscriber count) pulled straight from Paradox Mods - just like content pack buildings. Pure UI addition: buildings, saves and the catalog are untouched. 0.3.2: more service buildings - post & communications (post offices, sorting facilities) and parks & recreation buildings (82 on a fully updated game with DLC) join the catalog, each with its own tab (12 tabs total, all using vanilla icons - the communications tab shows the classic white three-dot bubble). Everything places as pure scenery: no cost, no service, and vanilla parking spots keep working on their lots - cars park and leave just like on any building. 0.3.1: icon tabs - the category tabs now use the vanilla zoning and service icons (plus an asterisk for All) instead of text labels; hover a tab to see its name in your language. No assets are copied - icons load straight from the game files, so they stay in sync with the vanilla look. 0.3.0: service buildings - schools, hospitals, fire stations and police & administration buildings join the catalog (64 on a fully updated base game, more with DLC), each group with its own tab. Style, density and level filters now apply only on zoned-building tabs (kept but paused elsewhere), while width/depth filters work everywhere and gain a ">6 cells" option. Service buildings display their own vanilla icons and place as pure shells: no cost, no unlock requirements, no simulation. Also fixed: selecting a service building no longer opens the vanilla service panel. Earlier releases (0.1.0-0.2.0): signature buildings, icon tabs, selected-item highlight, AIL building icons (optional), Mixed Housing tab, style/level filters with notes, panel ">6 cells" size options, big performance and startup-catalog rebuilds, first public build.
